rationale: C14 is the closest because it is also a presidential letter seeking congressional action on proposed legislation, but its shared material is limited to routine advocacy for prompt enactment and it lacks the child's distinctive sequence of endorsing a Cabinet secretary's recommendations, asking committees to develop corrective legislation, and designating that secretary as the President's congressional representative. C21 likewise recommends congressional legislation, while C06 discusses a legislative objective and assigns an administrator a study, but neither supplies concrete language or administrative machinery plausibly reused in the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hope that the Armed Services Committees will develop the needed corrective legislation for action by the Congress during the present session.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I would appreciate your aid in having the bill introduced in the Senate... and... in securing the passage of the bill as soon as practicable.
shared_material.explanation: C14 shares a request for prompt congressional action, but this is generic legislative-correspondence language rather than a distinctive drafting template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hope that the Armed Services Committees will develop the needed corrective legislation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I therefore strongly recommend that the Congress enact legislation authorizing this great undertaking.
shared_material.explanation: C21 also advocates enactment, but provides no parallel sequence or adapted administrative mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have asked him to act as my representative and to work in conjunction with your Committee and with the other appropriate committees of the Congress.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I should like to ask you, therefore, to undertake a comprehensive study... In preparing this report, you will undoubtedly wish to confer with interested persons both in and out of the Government.
shared_material.explanation: C06 assigns work to an executive official and anticipates consultation, but the task, audience, and machinery are materially different and the resemblance is only functional at a broad level.
